facts.claim: Factory VIN position 7 A identifies 6AT FWD, position 8 Z identifies 2.0T A20NFT/LHU, position 10 B identifies model year 2011.
Saab Parts advisory extends cold-intake-valve face-wear symptom to 2011 NG9-5 A20NFT; true cold compression/leakdown is specified; failure frequency unknown.
Factory AF40 level checking requires scan-tool-observed ATF temperature 70–80 C and engine running under specified procedures.
Factory generic cooling description includes coolant level reporting via BCM and an ATF-to-coolant radiator-integrated heat exchanger; exact VIN/engine variant must be checked.
Generic WIS cooling prose describes belt-driven water pump while specific 2.0L service index documents water-pump/balance-shaft chain; exact LHU procedure/hardware governs.
GNE FWD rear support can be disassembled/replaced by factory procedure; body mounting integrity and GNC versus GNE identity not proved by that alone.

investigation_cases.title: cold intake valve sealing
investigation_cases.lead_symptoms: Overnight cold no-start, starts/stalls, P0300-P0304; normal hot operation does not clear risk
investigation_cases.required_tests: Professionally measured truly cold compression and leak-down; retain raw per-cylinder values
investigation_cases.caution: Do not mislabel ignition fault or approve internal head work from codes alone

investigation_cases.title: oil pressure / bearings / pump / pickup
investigation_cases.lead_symptoms: Oil-pressure warning, knock, noise; poor service history
investigation_cases.required_tests: Safe qualified mechanical pressure test at documented temp/RPM; inspect pickup/pump/filter/sender
investigation_cases.caution: No cranking when suspected oil-starved or seized

investigation_cases.title: timing and balance-shaft chain
investigation_cases.required_tests: Inspect with WIS method; verify mechanical health before running
investigation_cases.caution: Separate water-pump/balance chain and primary chain; no blanket replacement interval

investigation_cases.title: returnless fuel control / direct injection
investigation_cases.lead_symptoms: No start, fuel pressure error, misfire
investigation_cases.required_tests: Get ECM and pump-module data; test low-pressure vs high-pressure sides with approved instruments
investigation_cases.caution: Do not condemn HP fuel pump or work on pressurized lines from symptom alone

investigation_cases.title: cooling system fan and coolant level
investigation_cases.required_tests: Inspect level/pressure/leaks, fan relays/resistors/G106 and codes before replacement
investigation_cases.caution: LHU water-pump drive conflict in generic page remains unresolved

investigation_cases.title: AF40 gearbox and integrated cooling
investigation_cases.lead_symptoms: Slipping, delayed engagement, coolant/ATF mixing, fluid leak
investigation_cases.required_tests: Verify case label/TCM faults and fluid/coolant condition; qualified temperature-controlled 70–80°C level service if safe
investigation_cases.caution: No unsupervised stall test or flushing unknown damaged gearbox

investigation_cases.title: rear support vs body mount rust
investigation_cases.lead_symptoms: Flaking/perforated rear support; suspected anchor, sill or floor damage
investigation_cases.required_tests: Professional inspection of metal integrity and rear support BODY mounts
investigation_cases.caution: Reject unsupported assumptions that removable subframe solves rusted structure

investigation_cases.title: scarce option-dependent body lighting and trim
investigation_cases.lead_symptoms: Missing/cracked headlamps, bumper and rear lamp
investigation_cases.required_tests: Verify exact VIN and options plus real deliverable quote or lawful used donor before purchase
investigation_cases.caution: Do not call a part universally extinct from one unavailable retail listing

service_findings.claim: Pump service requires EN-44602 to retain the sprocket/chain. Incorrect handling can over-stress the timing drive and cause noise/damage. Balance timing errors can cause vibration.
Chain installation requires actuator locking, correct timed links, new actuator bolts and tensioner reset/release. A replacement-kit number alone is not a complete repair procedure.
Head installation requires new main head bolts, specified sequence/angle tightening and no added gasket sealing material. This does not establish a revised valve metallurgy or guaranteed cure.
Rail removal discards the high-pressure pipe; installation uses a new pipe. Injector extraction may need specified tools. Bare-pump pricing excludes these possible job dependencies.

TCM replacement calls for SPS, adaptation reset and selector learning in neutral. Stable power and the module-specific programming path matter; current 2026 tool/subscription/security access remains unverified.

Factory 2.0T description identifies oil feed/return and coolant cooling, and requires synthetic oil for high-temperature performance. It does not measure turbo failure frequency or prove an aftermarket oil-line upgrade.

stages.title: Identity and legal documents
capture: privately match full VIN on title, body and manufacturer labels; seller authority and liens

photograph engine and transmission identifiers, case tags and prior swap invoices privately
stages.stop_when: Title/VIN tampering or unlawful transaction; confirmed excluded configuration is outside this project
stages.hold_when: missing title/ownership proof, mismatched VIN, uncertain engine/transmission identity

stages.title: Storage history and safe access
capture: last ran/moved dates, reason parked, exact seller fault description and invoices
battery swelling/leakage, rodent wiring, fuel odor/leaks, fluids and signs of flood/fire
confirm competent person approves any lifting/cranking; no unsupported structure access
stages.stop_when: unsafe fuel leak, fire/flood damage to safety systems or structure, unsafe support points
stages.hold_when: history or underside cannot be inspected; suspected seizure/hydrolock/oil starvation means no cranking until assessed

stages.title: Structure, accident damage and chassis
capture: subframes AND body attachment metal, sills, floor, suspension/steering anchors, brake/fuel line corrosion
crash repairs, buckling, missing bolts, seam separation and alignment evidence
distinguish flaking coating from confirmed section loss; qualified structural inspection
stages.stop_when: confirmed unsafe load-bearing corrosion/accident damage or required structural restoration beyond objective
stages.hold_when: hidden mounts, substantial scaling or accident repairs not evaluated

stages.title: Cold engine health before start
capture: overnight ambient/ECT/IAT and whether seller pre-warmed engine
qualified cold compression and leakdown per cylinder with exact conditions/units when indicated
crank authorization, plugs/fluid inspection and diagnostic sequence; preserve raw readings
stages.stop_when: confirmed internal head/valve, bearing, piston or timing damage requiring work outside accepted no-rebuild goal
stages.hold_when: warm demonstration only, unmeasured suspicious cold no-start, timing noise or unknown pressure; codes alone do not identify cause

stages.title: Lubrication, timing, turbo and cooling
capture: oil condition/filter debris, coolant contamination, leak locations and documented service
qualified mechanical oil pressure at factory temperature/RPM and timing inspection if warranted
pump/thermostat/fan/pressure tests and turbo feed/return/charge-air condition only after safe running approval
stages.stop_when: confirmed destructive low oil pressure, metal/bearing damage, serious overheat/internal damage or unsafe active leak
stages.hold_when: unexplained rattle/pressure warning, untested cooling/fan system, seller only says turbo or sensor

stages.title: Fuel and emissions
capture: fuel age, contamination and leaks; vehicle emission label
separate low-pressure pump/control from DI rail/pump actual-versus-commanded values
use approved pressure-relief and fuel tools; retain codes/freeze frames, no casual pressurized-line opening

stages.hold_when: unresolved no-start, missing catalytic hardware or unknown legal replacement; do not purchase pump from codes alone
